title: Pre-flight: every service, setting, workflow and task proved working before Start the system
why: Jason, 2026-11-16 (decisions/0163 §10's note) and 2026-11-17 ("yes start the preflight session now"): a page that goes through each item and proves it is connected and ready before the engine launches. 1. System Configuration → Pre-flight (https://traversence.com/admin/config/preflight): a queue log, one line per check in run order, a green ✓, red ✗, spinner or grey dash; each line opens to what was tested, the service's own answer and its fix (a button where the site can fix it, the URL where Jason must), marked needed for launch or optional. 2. What it tests, each real, free and read-only: the four databases, .env, database updates, the scheduler's jobs in cPanel, the workers' shared key, HEALTH_TOKEN, staging's gate; every Outside services company (one list: each card's Test is its line), including Turnstile's secret with a made-up token, SES GetAccount, Claude's and Gemini's model lists, Stripe's and Square's sandboxes, Name.com's sandbox search with a price, Fly reading the edge's certificates, GitHub's tokens and their expiry, Meta's app token, the mail server's sign-in without sending, Supabase awake, locked down and the index complete; Railway's API finding both services, the crawler and W0 still paused, W0 checking in, and W0's full-size test batch sent by the sleeping w0-indexer service (marked test, never stored; worker 1.1.0 in main); four heavy queries timed against limits in Thresholds; then each workflow in Start the system's order (its services, jobs, crawler tasks, gate, a dry run where there's a preview), the new tasks, and 0164's six phases. 3. Its own process: runs any time, never starts, pauses or changes anything; Start the system shows its latest result first and names what a red line needed for launch holds; it runs again nightly and within 15 minutes of a .env change (preflight_tick); red lines are one Pulse case, "Pre-flight", a step per line. 4. Outside services links to it; the table view of Outside services follows as its own release.

items: No new fatal errors in the logs

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
